name: Evil Twin
detailed_description:
Evil Twin is a first-person psychological horror game that plunges players into a surreal purgatory shaped by guilt, science, and madness. You’ll explore a haunting world filled with cryptic puzzles, eerie environments, and symbolic storytelling — all from the perspective of a brilliant scientist trapped in her own mind.

🔬 A Tragic Experiment Gone Wrong

Lan Anh, a gifted researcher at Py King Corporation, made a devastating mistake by testing experimental cell programming on human subjects. Her actions led to the suffering of millions. After attempting suicide, she awakens in a twisted, nightmarish maze — a purgatory of her own making — where she must confront her guilt and symbolically repair the damage she caused.

🏢 The Rise of Py King Corporation

Py King is a powerful weapons technology conglomerate that secretly funded Lan Anh’s research. After her disappearance, the corporation repurposed her discoveries to develop highly destructive biological weapons. Their experiments spiraled out of control, turning the once-thriving city of Caro on Caranaires Island into a wasteland overrun by the undead.

This dark chapter of the story will be fully explored in the upcoming sequel, Evil Twin 2, where players will uncover the truth behind Py King’s ambitions and the consequences of unchecked scientific power.

🧩 Psychological Horror Meets Puzzle Solving

Explore disturbing environments, uncover hidden clues, and solve environmental puzzles to progress. The game emphasizes atmosphere, tension, and psychological depth. In the full release, players will also be able to craft weapons from collected items to survive increasingly hostile encounters.

🖼️ AI-Generated Haunted Art

To enhance the surreal and unsettling atmosphere, many of the paintings and wall hints scattered throughout the game are generated using AI. These artworks serve both as visual storytelling and cryptic clues, adding a layer of mystery and unease to every room.

📖 In-Game Guidance

A fully integrated in-game menu provides players with detailed tutorials and guidance throughout the experience. Whether you're solving puzzles or navigating the environment, helpful prompts and instructions will ensure you never feel lost.

🎮 Key Features

  • Immersive First-Person Perspective: Experience the horror through Lan Anh’s eyes in a deeply personal and atmospheric journey.

  • Puzzle-Based Progression: Solve environmental and logic-based puzzles to unlock new areas and memories.

  • Symbolic Storytelling: Every room, object, and sound tells a piece of the story — if you’re willing to look deeper.

  • Crafting System (Full Release): Collect and combine items to create tools or weapons to aid your survival.

  • AI-Generated Clues: Mysterious paintings and wall hints created by AI enhance the game’s eerie tone.

  • In-Game Tutorial System: A built-in guide helps players understand mechanics and objectives.

  • Progress System: The game is automatically saving after one chapter completed with banner popup showing.

  • Estimated Playtime: ~2 hours in Early Access, ~10 hours in the full release.

  • Inspired by Visage: Fans of Visage will find familiar tension and psychological horror elements.

short_description: A female scientist of Py King Corporation made a huge mistake when she directly tested cell tissue programming technology on the human body, causing suffering to millions of people. She was trapped in her own uncertain maze after jumping off a building to commit suicide,
supported_languages:
English*, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10, 11, or lastest
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: All System Requirements match with Released version (Build on Flax Engine) not Demo version (Unity).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11 or lastest
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4070
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ASUS STRIX RAID PRO
  • VR Support: Occulus, Meta Quest
  • Additional Notes: All System Requirements match with Released version (Build on Flax Engine no need DirectX) not Demo version (Unity).

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences, including:
- Psychological horror themes and intense, disturbing imagery.
- Graphic violence involving shooting, melee combat, and dismemberment.
- Frequent depictions of blood, gore, and exposed internal organs.
- Occasional partial nudity in non-sexual contexts.
- Mild to moderate use of strong language in dialogue.
Viewer discretion is advised.
